data.body: Read the planned compaction, ingestion, lean-start and token-economy work; research per-model caching and compaction; write the research and a proposal; queue P-context-compaction (CC-).
data.title: Research: context compaction advisor, chat/summary store and cache-aware policy per model family

data.text: Make a research for automated proposal from the MCP to the subagents and the agent for context compaction (assuming ddflow logs all the chats and will log and store the summary so they will be available for the agents to search) for the agents depending on the model they use and the tasks, to keep the token usage low, and also depending on the model how to reuse best the token cache to optimize the cost. See what we plan to do, and add on top of it

data.body: Operator 2026-10-23 verbatim: 'Make a research for automated proposal from the MCP to the subagents and the agent for context compaction (assuming ddflow logs all the chats and will log and store the summary so they will be available for the agents to search) for the agents depending on the model they use and the tasks, to keep the token usage low, and also depending on the model how to reuse best the token cache to optimize the cost. See what we plan to do, and add on top of it'. Research: docs/ddflow/research/context-compaction.md (+ -cache.md); proposal: docs/ddflow/decisions/context-compaction.md. REUSES, does not rebuild: B195/services/compaction.py, B-am-ingest/handoff/search/restart-brief/retention, DX-resume-command, TE-* (TTL, caps, poll, measure, report), LS-budget-per-agent, SU-digest, RQM-doors, [reinstruct] footer, OD-*. Nothing here is built before CC-decide.
data.title: Context compaction: a per-harness/model advisor, instruction template, resume pack, session.compacted record, cache-prefix lint and cache metrics

data.body: WHAT: ask CC-Q1..Q9 of docs/ddflow/decisions/context-compaction.md (defaults stated there), record answers as decisions D-CC-*, update its Answers section; coordinate with TE-decide (thresholds and TTL are TE-Q answers: one value, one knob). WHY: option A/B/C, thresholds, whether ddflow manages the CLAUDE.md compact-instructions region, and whether PreCompact may ever block are operator choices. TEST: every question answered or defaulted on the record.
data.title: DECIDE (lead asks the operator): context-compaction questions CC-Q1..CC-Q9 with defaults; record each answer as D-CC-*

data.body: WHAT: ONE data table keyed by model family (claude, openai, gemini, deepseek, kimi, qwen, glm, unknown): cache kind (explicit|automatic|none), ttl options, read/write multipliers, min cacheable tokens, window, compaction kind, each fact a three-valued record (status, source, date) in the HX-facts-core shape; plus per-harness capabilities the advisor needs (can run a compaction command, which hooks accept additionalContext, usage fields in transcripts, ttl env). Run and record the probes listed in research section 11 (hooks that reach subagents, PostCompact fields, PreCompact fields, Kimi/Codex caching). REUSE: HX-facts-core (fact shape), B-am-harness-probe ([transcripts] stays there), SU-client-table (client capabilities), research/mcp-client-matrix.md. Do not edit harnesses/*.toml. WHY: model family differs from harness (Claude Code can run non-Claude models); prices move so they are dated data, never code. TEST: every harness id has a row or an explicit unknown; every fact has source and date; a fact older than [context].facts_max_age_days makes doctor note it; unverified is never read as true. ACCEPTANCE: probe record per UNVERIFIED line of research section 11.
data.title: Family and harness facts as data with provenance + live probes (hook payloads in subagents, PostCompact summary, Kimi cache, compaction-cold cache write)

data.body: WHAT: core/ctx_advice.advise(...) pure, no I/O, deterministic: levels none|suggest|strong|now; thresholds from the family table scaled by the effective budget and the task kind; break-even of research section 4 may lower a level, never raise it; hysteresis (once per crossing, reset after compaction); action text per harness (Claude lead: /compact <text>; lane: finish, handoff, rotate; Codex: /compact + compact_prompt; Pi: extension; closed IDE: text only). New [context_advice] section: enabled, levels, cooldown_s (20 min), per-role overrides; registers in config_sections/__init__.py and ddflow/config.py (shared hot files: two lines, short claim). CONSUMES the knobs of TE-context-caps ([session].agent_rotate_tokens etc.) so there is ONE threshold; proposes that TE-context-caps's rotate hint becomes a caller of this function (lead decides the fold; not done here). Context size comes from the last usage row of the transcript (input+cache_read+cache_creation) else bytes/4 labelled estimated; UNAVAILABLE not zero when unknown. TEST: table-driven goldens per family/role/kind, idle past ttl switches the cold wording, estimate never reads as measured, determinism (same input same text), tiny-budget case. FALSIFIER: advice ignored on >80% of crossings over 20 items: fold into TE-context-caps.
data.title: Compaction advisor: pure function (harness, model, usage, task kind, idle, ttl, state) -> level and exact action, with the policy table

data.body: WHAT: one template: keep verbatim the operator's instructions of this session (ids), item ids and worktree paths held, decision ids in force, pending approvals, next step; keep file:line pointers not contents; drop tool output, diffs, logs; end 'everything else is in ddflow: ddflow brief --resume, ddflow search'. Renderings: Claude /compact line and the managed '# Compact instructions' region for CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md (doc-regions; D-CC-Q2), Codex compact_prompt, Pi hook text, API instructions param. REUSE: B-am-handoff schema field names, B-am-eval/handoff verify for the probe questions, doc-regions engine. The text contains NO stored chat text. TEST: token cap by bytes/4, golden per harness, region idempotent and removable, a fixture summary produced from the instruction passes the B-am-handoff mechanical verify. NOTE: CLAUDE.md edits mid-session do not apply or bust the cache until /clear or /compact (VERIFIED) so installing the region is safe.
data.title: Compaction instruction template (<=150 tokens) rendered per harness; round-trip probe

data.body: WHAT: on SessionStart source=compact/PostCompact record ONE session.compacted {trigger manual|auto, context_tokens before/after (from usage rows), cache warm|cold, advice id or none, instructions sha, summary pointer (transcript turn or handoff id; opaque summaries pointer only)}; declared as data via SE-event-registry (templates/events), redacted, size-capped, retention keep. Adds the anchor --before-compaction[=N] to the filters of B-am-search/B-am-session-cli so 'recall my instructions from before the compaction' = the recorded operator prompts (session.prompt) of that session before that event, deterministic, no model. REUSE: B-am-ingest (reader, redaction, <private>), B-am-handoff (summary text), B-am-retention (caps; 500 MB/90 d per D-agent-memory-defaults), SE-sensitivity egress, provenance fence. Does NOT add a second reader or store. TEST: fixture transcript with isCompactSummary; event idempotent on replay; secret planted in summary never stored; anchor returns exactly the prompts before the event; opaque summary stored as pointer. D-no-deletion: nothing removed.
data.title: session.compacted event, advice-to-outcome link, and the --before-compaction anchor for session search/prompts

data.body: WHAT: deterministic builder (no model): claimed items with lease, worktree, branch; last gate state and owed gates per item; last 5 decisions in force (id + title); open approvals; last 3 operator prompts verbatim (redacted); handoff skeleton when B-am-handoff exists; exact next command; fenced as recorded DATA, hard cap [context_advice].pack_max_tokens (1500) with the first lines (leases, owed gates, operator words) never cut. Works from the log alone today; richer when B-am-* land. COMPOSES DX-resume-command (resume brief) and B-am-restart-brief (previous-run section), does not replace them; the door wiring (brief section) stays in those tasks, doors for this builder are CC-hooks and CC-mcp. WHY: the 2026-10-23 spend-limit stops (15 subagent runs) made agents re-read everything; a compaction summary is lossy. TEST: golden for a seeded state, budget tiny keeps lease+owed gates, two agents' packs never cross, instruction planted in a prompt stays inside the fence, byte-identical for the same state.
data.title: Resume pack builder: live state in <=1500 tokens for compaction, spend-limit/429 stop, fresh lane

data.body: WHAT: ctx_nudge builds the text; delivery by the doors a harness lists in inject: SessionStart compact|resume (resume pack; on resume uses payload seconds_since_last_response, context_tokens, prompt_cache_likely_expired, estimated_cache_write_usd, VERIFIED v2.1.251+), SubagentStart (pack), PostToolUse and UserPromptSubmit additionalContext (advice, once per level per session, cooldown, silent while waiting/polling), and the [reinstruct] footer obligation for MCP-only clients. Registers as a provider with hookdoors/B-rc-context when those land (RQM-doors does the same); until then through the existing handlers. DEPENDS ON THE FIX of B1878cc0da3 (prompt door delivers 0 bytes) and a descriptor change inject += post_tool for claude, which belong to that bug's fix task and the descriptor owners: file/ask, do not patch here. Never blocks, never raises (hook rule, B195); exit 0. TEST: transcript fixtures: crossing fires once, cooldown holds, reset after compaction, resume with expired cache words the cold case, hook failure silent, no stored chat text in the nudge, golden bytes.
data.title: Nudges and re-injection through hook doors: once per level, cooldown, resume pack after compaction/resume and at subagent start

data.body: WHAT: lint over the interface ddflow serves per (version, profile, config): tools/list order sorted and byte-identical across two builds, no timestamps/ids/counters/paths in tool descriptions or MCP instructions, digest (SU-digest) stable under a no-op config reload; volatile text only in the conversation layer (SessionStart, footers). A doctor line (added after TE-subagent-ttl lands: both touch api/reporting/health.py) reports lint result and the effective TTL. RULE with SU-announce/SU-restart-notice: for a client the table says does NOT defer MCP tools, a non-urgent tool-list change waits for a cache-cold moment (idle > ttl, compaction, restart); hard upgrades unaffected; Claude Code defers by default (VERIFIED) so no wait. Also the standard brief: shared fixed prefix, per-item part last (LS-launch-brief-budget owns size). TEST: lint fails on an injected timestamp in a description; sorted-order test; digest stable; swap deferred for a non-deferring fixture client and immediate for a deferring one. FALSIFIER: unexplained cache-creation spikes in CC-usage-metrics do not fall.
data.title: Cache-prefix lint and doctor line: byte-stable tool list and instructions; swap timing for non-deferring clients

data.body: WHAT: pure functions over normalised usage rows (session, agent, ts, model, input, cache_read, cache_creation 5m/1h, output): hit ratio, rewrite events after gaps >= ttl by preceding tool class, unexplained busts (creation spike with no gap, no compaction, no model change; cause list from ddflow: interface digest change, profile switch, upgrade), per-compaction outcome (before/after, summary tokens, files re-read in next 10 calls, operator prompt repeated via textsim), regression test week over week (hit ratio -10 points, busts > 1/day). Row source: TE-measure's parser now, B-am-ingest rows later (one adapter line); cost per merged item joins B-gap-metrics/B-gap-spend; UNAVAILABLE not zero; aggregates only, no text. Also reads Claude statusline prompt_cache fields when present. TEST: fixture rows with known sums; missing usage -> UNAVAILABLE; bust classifier table; regression detector on seeded series.
data.title: Cache and compaction metrics: hit ratio, rewrite events, unexplained busts, compaction outcome, regressions

data.body: WHAT: a hint field in the advisor output and the dispatch plan: (1) wake a stopped lane only inside the cache TTL or when its context < ~70 K, else fresh lane from the resume pack (research section 4); (2) a model switch is a full rebuild of C, so change model only at a lane boundary or compaction, cost shown via GV-switch-cost; (3) task class -> cheaper model hint table (mechanical fix, doc, research reader) as data. LINKS, does not implement: TE-model-routing (measure first, A/B), GV-roles/GV-switch-cost (D-model-routing), TE-context-caps. Cross-family review rule unchanged; reviewers stay strongest. TEST: wake-or-fresh table goldens, no hint without measured usage (UNAVAILABLE), hint never overrides a configured model.
data.title: Cache-aware routing hints: model per lane at launch, never mid-conversation; wake-or-fresh rule

data.body: WHAT: the lead cannot run /compact itself; the operator (or the harness) does. Register one source in the OD-inventory table ('compaction advised' for a lead/lane session at strong or now, default: ignore, answer: the exact /compact line) and one digest section line 'context: lead 420K warm; agents over 250K: N; cache hit 93%' from CC-advisor/CC-usage-metrics. Deterministic, within the OD token budget, UNAVAILABLE not zero. TEST: golden digest with and without advice; entry resurfaces with age per OD rules; an agent cannot mark it seen (OD-seen).
data.title: Operator digest line for the lead's context: size, cache state, advised action

data.body: WHAT: declare once in the command registry: ddflow session advise [--context-tokens N] [--idle S] [--json] and ddflow session resume-pack [--for ITEM|AGENT]; MCP: actions of the existing session family (D-mcp-new-nouns, D-mcp-surface), same schema, CLI/MCP parity test, byte budget reported by MTD-budget-test. advise returns {level, action, instruction (rendered), why, cache note}; resume-pack returns the fenced pack. TEST: parity test passes, schema tokens within the family budget, determinism.
data.title: MCP/CLI surface: session family action 'advise' (and 'resume-pack'), no new tool

data.body: WHAT: a short snippet (<= 12 lines) included by the driver and lane brief: compact at gate boundaries not mid-edit; rotate after complete; relay advice lines verbatim to the operator; use ddflow session resume-pack after a stop; do not wake a lane past the TTL for a small delta; bounded waits. The one-line include in docs/ddflow/drivers/implement-phase.md is made by the owner of that file (TE-report-protocol) or serialized after it; this task writes the snippet only. TEST: snippet token cap, referenced by the brief template, no tool name that does not exist (tool-name lint).
data.title: Prompts and driver lines: when to compact, rotate, wake-or-fresh, standard brief prefix

data.body: WHAT: fixture transcripts (lead, lane, Codex-shaped, no-usage) drive hooks: advice fires once per level, cooldown holds, compaction recorded (session.compacted), SessionStart:compact injects the pack, search --before-compaction returns the operator prompts, spend-limit stop then resume yields a pack with leases and owed gates, planted secret and injection string never leave the fence, digest line present, replay from the log reproduces state, token budget of every injected text within the cap. TEST is the task.
data.title: End to end: scripted session crosses thresholds, compacts, resumes after a limit stop; nudges once; nothing sensitive stored

data.body: WHAT: operator and agent guide: what ddflow can and cannot do per harness, the knobs, how to read the digest line, how to run /compact with the instruction, the TTL and caps settings (link TE-docs, do not repeat), troubleshooting (unexplained busts, ignored advice). README only through the single README editor.
data.title: Docs: compaction and cache guide (settings, instruction region, advice levels, resume pack, metrics), help topic
